verdict.rationale: Twilio Video documents Status Callbacks. You register a StatusCallback URL on Rooms (via the REST API) and on Composition Hooks, and Twilio sends HTTP webhook requests whenever events occur in Rooms, Recordings, and Compositions, including periodic composition progress reports. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of webhook signature verification and retry semantics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Status Callbacks allow you to receive events related to the REST resources managed by Twilio: Rooms, Recordings, and Compositions.
Configure a `StatusCallback` URL when creating a Room using the REST API, and Twilio will make an HTTP request (webhook) to that URL whenever an event takes place in the Room.
When you create a Composition Hook, you can set the `StatusCallback` URL at such Hook.
Use this API to set Room properties such as its name, type, TURN configuration, webhook status callback URL, and the maximum number of Participants.
